goal: Implement and promote the Claude Code Host defined by docs/specs/claude-code-host.spec.md: ship one self-contained plugin that consumes the shared Assurance coordinator and existing Kernel, independently completes routine, material, and critical tasks with native interaction and Review evidence, supports safe Pi/Claude bidirectional resume, preserves Pi and persisted compatibility, and binds public support claims to deterministic tests plus a versioned real-Host conformance report accepted at final critical authorization.

acceptance.assertion: Drives shared coordinator; no second state machine. ElicitationResult requires nonempty Host session_id (aliases/env rejected), nonempty string tool_use_id/toolCallId, exact decisions accept/deny/cancel; request_id never identifies it. Wire correlation accepts only the namespaced claudecode/toolUseId key, never aliases or wire session ids; session identity comes from unique unconsumed ElicitationResult; missing/ambiguous fail closed. Unknown nonempty CLAUDE_CODE_PERMISSION_MODE fails before authority; absent defaults manual. SubagentStart binds exact operationId/prompt (mismatched taskId rejected); delayed, conflicting, replayed fail closed. Review receipts require/reconcile Start, result, Stop in one session >= cursor with exact non-empty agentId/operation, any arrival permutation. PostToolUse requires reserved agentId and matching operationId (nested in top-level/tool_input/tool_response; conflicts fail closed). Consumption claims atomically per-key (O_EXCL) and verifies durable record before session evidence; survives restart, rejects replay; SessionEnd clears unconsumed. Hooks use per-session sequence; drain advances to snapshot length; SessionEnd clears it; later reservations cannot skip events. Hook cache: hashed session IDs, 0700 dir, 0600 files; symlinks/wrong mode rejected; no-follow opens block traversal. Enrollment and user ops hash intent revisions and digests before consuming elicitation; breaking revisions stage and revalidate candidate digest as confirmation_ref, restoring prior bytes and index on abort (surfacing any restoration errors). MCP derives version and interactivity only from initialize: clientInfo.name claude-code, stable non-prerelease >= 2.1.199, valid elicitation object; absent/unparseable versions and non-status calls on non-interactive sessions fail closed; status stays usable. Unsupported, non-interactive, denied, cancelled, missing, wrong-task, stale, malformed, or replayed evidence causes zero mutation.

Claude independently progresses routine, material, and critical TaskRecords, and Pi and Claude resume compatible v4-current and v3-drain tasks in both directions from active, frozen/run-QA, run-Review, authorize-user, and terminal projections without Host handoff state; public packaged and domain docs (plugin README, USER_GUIDE, CONTEXT) describe TaskRecord v4 as the current production authority and v3 as drain-only; stdin end stops new tools/call intake, aborts cancellable in-flight work, waits for started Kernel mutations to complete or reconcile through the existing Projection, flushes JSON-RPC replies, then shuts down; incompatible versions, stale Git identity, simultaneous continuation, cancellation, disconnect, and postcommit ambiguity fail closed or reconcile through the existing Kernel projection; request_authorization derives its exact Kernel operation from the projection's authorization readiness, resolving the single bound user decision when one is open. (round 31)

The root release ships Pi and one self-contained Claude Code plugin at one version, with valid marketplace/plugin/MCP/Hook/Reviewer manifests, generated Node runtime using newline-delimited JSON-RPC stdio (validates full '2.0' request/call envelope) and drift guard, five canonical Skill sources, exact Pi+Claude allowlisting including the root .claude-plugin marketplace in npm files, plugin_versioning requiring plugin.json and validating it against package.json at one version, Changesets version stamping the plugin manifest, minimum capability and platform checks, cache-safe paths, and unchanged Pi package installation; the reviewed revision must include every packaged Claude runtime and Hook file; undeclared Hosts and unsupported Claude/core versions remain rejected before authority writes.

A sanitized conformance report bound to package.json, minimum Claude Code 2.1.199, and the installed CLI records plugin validation and every required scenario, separating real-Host session observations (wire capture, status round-trip, permission denial, privileged fail-closed, hook event integrity) from contract-fixture and hitl-final evidence classes; no row presents fixture evidence as real-Host observation, and every cited verification path exists in the reviewed revision. Review receipts require reservation-bound SubagentStart; SessionEnd recomputes the log cursor. Public support claims consistently identify Pi and local interactive Claude Code as supported hosts; live TUI clicks remain HITL evidence accepted only at final critical user authorization, not as a QA attestation or Kernel authority.
